integrity: Analytic proof of all parameter ranges; a standalone integer cyclotomic checker provides corroboration at finite sizes only. No independent audit or external mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only squarefree cyclic groups, spatial sets of size equal to their least prime factor, and exactly orthogonal complex Fourier characters; no generalization to other group orders, approximate frames, or all cardinalities is claimed. Historical priority may be affected by full details in an inaccessible 2026 squarefree Fuglede paper.
title: Exact exponential-spectrum multiplicities at the least-prime cardinality of squarefree cyclic groups
